name: Looking Further
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep.  I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.

Take another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.

Find a suitable object on which to place the Glyph.  A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
narrative.objectives:
Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.

Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
narrative.offerRewardText: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.
narrative.requestItemsText: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 21 to 27, 5,300 XP in all.

quests.name: A Watchful Eye
quests.objectiveText: Take the Glyph of Azora to the Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge.

quests.name: Looking Further
quests.objectiveText: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep. Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.

quests.name: Morganth
quests.objectiveText: Defeat Morganth. Bring his Pendant of Shadow to Theocritus at the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
